scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,green "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm web:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm web:build && pnpm api:build
scripts.check: pnpm collab:test && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm verify:runtime && pnpm grammar:check && pnpm content:audit && pnpm content:why-today && pnpm tarot:audit && pnpm content:review && pnpm experience:audit && pnpm rewrite:corpus && pnpm web:lint && pnpm web:typecheck && pnpm web:test && pnpm api:lint && pnpm api:typecheck && pnpm api:test && pnpm qa:test && pnpm web:e2e
scripts.qa:build: pnpm astro:build-native && pnpm astro:verify-assets && pnpm web:build
scripts.qa:test: node --test scripts/qa-server.test.mjs && pnpm qa:build && node scripts/qa-cli-smoke.mjs
scripts.api:build: uv run --directory apps/api python -m compileall -q app
scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check app tests scripts migrations && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check app tests scripts migrations
scripts.api:typecheck: uv run --directory apps/api mypy app tests scripts
scripts.verify:runtime: node scripts/verify-no-mock-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-privacy.mjs && node scripts/verify-mobile-config.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --directory apps/api python -m scripts.export_openapi --check && pnpm --filter @la-lanh/contracts check
scripts.grammar:check: uv run --directory apps/api python -m scripts.grammar_build --check && uv run --directory apps/api python -m scripts.fallback_approval --check
